thread:
sam: Heads up — NovaCart (tenant=novacart-prod) on Dedicated EU-West pool is doing a rapid scale up/down loop for ~30m. Customers seeing 429s and a big billing spike. Posting notes + quick repro.

oncall-bot: incident created INC-4821 for tenant=novacart-prod (assigned: eng-sre)

maria: Any idea what metric is tripping the autoscaler? CPU, GPU utilization, request_rate?

sam: From initial telemetry: short high-rate bursts every ~3m (30–45s long), request_rate jumps then drops. Autoscaler configured to use 1m avg -> we see scale up, then very quick scale down once burst ends. Example PromQL we used to inspect:

```promql
sum by(pool) (rate(redwood_requests_total{pool="ded-eu-west-3", tenant="novacart-prod"}[1m]))
```

Spikes hit ~8k rps for 30s, baseline ~300 rps.

jordan: I pulled the scaling auditor logs. Decision loop shows scale_up when util>75% for 60s, scale_down when util<30% for 60s. Cooldown is 60s. That's too short for these bursts -> oscillation. Logs:

```
[2026-03-17T18:04:12Z] pool=ded-eu-west-3 util=82% -> scale_up -> desired=6 -> applied
[2026-03-17T18:05:20Z] util=28% -> scale_down -> desired=2 -> applied
```

alex: Customer also reported intermittent auth 401s during the churn window (not constant). Could be token validation cache misses while new replica spun up and warmup hasn't pulled key caches yet.

kyle-support: I ran a lightweight repro: a 45s burst every 3m against a staging replica of novacart-prod. Script attached: 

```bash
# load-burst.sh
for i in {1..10}; do
  hey -z 45s -q 0 -c 400 "https://staging.redwood.example/api/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  sleep 95
done
```

Observed the same scale bounce. Collected autoscaler events + trace IDs -> gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abc123 (logs + traces)

maria: Good repro. Two-pronged fix: 1) tuning autoscaler/hysteresis for that pool, 2) add short-lived request-queueing (or tolerate burst via burst capacity) so we don't spin down too fast. Proposal:

- scale_up: require util>80% for 180s (3m)
- scale_down: require util<40% for 300s (5m)
- cooldown window: 300s
- enable soft-burst reserve for tenant novacart-prod (allow short spikes without immediate scale decisions)

sam: +1. Also add a pre-warm hook to populate auth key caches during replica start to avoid 401s while warmup happening.

jordan: I'll own the runtime change. Plan: apply to staging pool today, run the same burst script for 2h, check for oscillation and 5xx/401 noise. If green, schedule rollout to prod pool during low-traffic window. Creating runtime ticket RT-8732.

oncall-bot: created ticket RT-8732 (runtime/autoscaler) linked to INC-4821

kyle-support: Noted — I'll message the customer to throttle scheduled batch jobs as temporary mitigation and share expected timeline.

sam: Action items recap:
- jordan -> change hysteresis + cooldown for ded-eu-west-3 (staging -> test -> prod)
- sam -> add pre-warm auth cache hook proposal (PR)
- kyle-support -> customer communication + ask to delay batch windows
- maria -> monitor billing alerts and attach relevant spikes to INC-4821

jordan: assigning to myself, will post staging results here. :white_check_mark:

sam: Thanks — keeping INC-4821 open until we see 30m stable in prod. :eyes:
